thread:
carla (Acme): hi team — we're seeing intermittent 429s from the API since ~09:12 UTC, ~2% of requests fail. sample reqids from our logs: rq_abc123, rq_def456. can you collect a debug bundle and help debug? app is prod-us-east. quick curl we used: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-4o\",\"prompt\":\"test\"}'`

jess (support): thanks @carla :wave: can you paste the full response headers from one of the 429s (should include x-request-id and x-rate-limit-*). if possible upload a HAR or run curl with `--trace`/`--trace-ascii`. i'll loop in eng.

carla (Acme): pasting one full 429 response headers we captured:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: rq_abc123
x-rate-limit-limit: 120
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 1670000
x-server-region: us-east-1
content-type: application/json

body: {"error":{"message":"Rate limit exceeded","type":"rate_limit_error"}}

jess (support): perfect, thanks. @raj can you take a look? reqids: rq_abc123, rq_def456. customer reports burst window ~09:12-09:18 UTC, short spikes ~200 rps. they have Dedicated but traffic may have fallen back to hosted.

raj (eng): on it. carla — can you share a HAR or a curl replay we can run locally? if not, please share request logpack and client IPs so we can correlate. also include any retry policy you use.

carla (Acme): uploading HAR now — private link: https://acme.example/hars/session-2026-06-10.har
also a short reproducer we ran:

```
curl -v --header 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' --data-raw '{"model":"gpt-4o","prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

oncall-bot: Deploybot: Canary rollout for model gpt-4o at 09:05 UTC completed successfully on us-east-1. No infra alerts.

jess (support): thanks. raj — i'll send the HAR + reqids via secure share. carla — can you also re-run the reproducer with an explicit X-Request-Id header so we can trace it, e.g. `curl -H 'X-Request-Id: test-req-789' ...` and paste the response headers?

carla (Acme): done — response for `X-Request-Id: test-req-789` below:
x-request-id: test-req-789
status: 429
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 1670020

i'll drop the debug bundle (app + proxy logs for 09:00-09:30 UTC) into the S3 share in ~10m.

raj (eng): receiving the files now. initial look shows multiple samples with remaining=0 -> likely client-side burst pushing over the per-minute bucket. we'll correlate with proxy and token usage. jess, can we request server-side trace for rq_abc123 and rq_def456?

jess (support): yes — eng oncall, please run trace for those reqids and include per-minute token counts and backend routing. pinging @lee.

lee (infra): got it. starting trace now for rq_abc123 & rq_def456, collecting proxy, router, and model pool logs. will post histograms and any fallback routing evidence in ~15m.

carla (Acme): appreciate it — one more question: does Redwood have leaky-bucket smoothing on Dedicated? we triggered a retry storm and want to know if smoothing would have prevented the throttle.

raj (eng): we do have burst-smoothing configs for Dedicated. i'll check this customer's policy and whether traffic hit a fallback tier. will report back with findings and recommended mitigations (client-side retry jitter, lower per-second bursts, and/or provisioning higher burst capacity). :eyes:
